title: Stop Enderman Picking Up Blocks
description: Stops endermen from picking up and moving blocks.
body:
Endermen can't pick up blocks.

No config, no commands. Drop it in your world's datapack folder and run `/reload`.

## What it changes
- Endermen cannot pick up any blocks
- Everything else stays the same. They still spawn, teleport, attack, and drop ender pearls.

## Installation
1. Download the datapack
2. Place the folder inside your world's `datapacks/` folder
3. Run `/reload` in-game or just load the world

## Compatibility
Works on Minecraft 26.1.2+.
